title: Resident Evil
synopsisShort:
Witness the origin of evil.

From the twisted mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) comes the terrifying and thrilling reinvention of the Resident Evil Franchise. Set during one fateful night, RESIDENT EVIL is a gory, terror filled horror of one man’s fight for survival.

Medical courier Bryan (Austin Abrams) accepts a routine job transporting a life-saving medical treatment to a remote hospital. However, the night quickly turns sinister when he loses contact with the outside world and he finds himself in a desperate race for survival against a horde of bloodthirsty, mutated creatures.

The highly anticipated next feature from the mastermind behind Weapons, Zach Cregger’s RESIDENT EVIL promises a darker, bloodier and even more terrifying reboot of the franchise. With standout performances from cast members, Austin Abrams, Paul Walter Hauser, Zach Cherry and Kali Reis, RESIDENT EVIL is not only a love letter to the video game series but a delight for all horror fans.
